```{r setup, include=FALSE}
set.seed(0)
```

```{r preparation}
#install.packages("gllvm")
library(gllvm)
library(tidyverse)

data(microbialdata)
microbial = data.frame(microbialdata)
dim(microbial)

Xenv = microbial[, 986:991]
Xenv[1:6, ]
Xenv[, 1:3]
df_noXenv = microbial %>%  #no X variables 
    dplyr::select(-(Xenv.SOM:Xenv.Soiltype))
```
```{r running gllvm 1 l.v.}
system.time({
  modelg = gllvm(microbial[, 1:200], Xenv[, 1:2], num.lv = 1, family = poisson(link = 'log'))
}) 
#4.658s elapsed

predicted_logmu = predict(modelg, type = 'link', lv.pred = TRUE) #account for latent variable
pred_counts = exp(predicted_logmu)

pearson_resid = (microbial[, 1:200] - pred_counts)/sqrt(pred_counts) 
sspearson_resid = sum(pearson_resid^2)
ds_residuals = residuals(modelg)
```

#simulations - take fitted model (known parameters) and simulate 100 times, conditional = TRUE to know u hence mu, then fit various methods, store comp time and KL distance 
```{r alternating glms using 1 latent variable}
system.time({u = rnorm(56, 0, 1) # simulating 56 observations for 1 latent variable

#model = glm(microbial[, 1] ~ Xenv[, 1] + Xenv[, 2] + u - 1, family=poisson(link='log'))
#beta_lambda = t(model$coefficients)

#beta = beta_lambda[, 1:2] #1 x 2
#lambda = beta_lambda[, 1] #1 x 1

#new_Xenv = cbind(Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2])
#model2 = glm(as.numeric(df_noXenv[1, ]) ~ lambda - 1, family=poisson(link='log'), offset = (new_Xenv%*%beta)[1, ])

beta_lambda = matrix(NA, nrow = length(microbial[, 1:200]), ncol = 3) #preset matrix of coefficients including betas and lambdas, nrow = no. of columns in the responses, no. of columns = beta1, beta2, lambda

loglik = -Inf
for (j in 1:20){

  for (i in 1:length(microbial[, 1:200])){
    model = glm.fit(y = df_noXenv[, i], x = cbind(Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2], u), intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log')) #without interc.
    beta_lambda[i, ] = t(model$coefficients) #1 x 3
  }
  beta_lambda #(intercept beta lambda)
  beta = beta_lambda[, 1:2] #200 x 2
  lambda = beta_lambda[, 3] #200 x 1
  
  new_Xenv = cbind(Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2]) #56 x 2
  new_u = matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(microbial), ncol = 1) #56 x 1
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(df_noXenv)){
    model2 = glm.fit(y = as.numeric(df_noXenv[i, 1:200]), x = lambda, intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), offset = (new_Xenv%*%t(beta))[i, ]) #invalid type without as.numeric
    new_u[i] = model2$coefficients 
  }
  u = new_u #56 x 1
  u
  eta = new_Xenv%*%t(beta) + u%*%t(lambda) #56 x 200 + 56 x 200
  mu = exp(eta)
  loglik_new = sum(dnorm(u, log = TRUE)) + sum(dpois(as.matrix(df_noXenv[, 1:200]), lambda = mu, log = TRUE))
  if(abs(loglik_new - loglik) < 1e-3) break
  loglik = loglik_new
}}) 

pred_counts2 = exp(eta)

pearson_resid = (df_noXenv[, 1:200] - pred_counts2)/sqrt(pred_counts2) 
sspearson_resid = sum(pearson_resid^2)

#AROUND 2X FASTER USING GLM.FIT VS GLM
#pearson residuals o-e, sum of squared pearson residuals ~ likelihood -- how well something is fitting the data 


#E(log_likelihood) - Kullback-liebler distance - expected difference in expected likelihoods for estimate and true value 
#sum_i [mu_ilog(hat_mu_i)-hat_mu] - [mu_ilog(mu_i)-mu_i]
#fairer to predictions with big variance from true
#do multiple times and average, standard errors 
```
```{r alternating glms using 2 l.v.}

#install.packages('glmnet')
library(MASS)
system.time({u = mvrnorm(n = 56, mu = c(0, 0), Sigma = matrix(c(1, 0, 0, 1), nrow = 2, ncol = 2)) # generate 56 'observations' involving 2 latent variables
beta_lambda = matrix(NA, nrow = length(microbial[1:200]), ncol = 4) #4 to account for 2 l.v and 2 betas

loglik = -Inf
for (j in 1:20){

  for (i in 1:length(microbial[, 1:200])){
    model = glm.fit(y = df_noXenv[, i], x = cbind(Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2], u), intercept = FALSE, family = poisson(link = 'log'))
    beta_lambda[i, ] = t(model$coefficients) #1 x 4
  }
  beta_lambda #(beta lambda)
  beta = beta_lambda[, 1:2] #200 x 2
  lambda = beta_lambda[, 3:4] #200 x 2, 2 col. now
  
  new_Xenv = cbind(Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2]) #56 x 2
  new_u = matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(microbial), ncol = 2) #56 x 2, 2 col. now

  for (i in 1:nrow(df_noXenv)){
    model2 = glm.fit(y = as.numeric(df_noXenv[i, 1:200]), x = lambda, intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), offset = (new_Xenv%*%t(beta))[i, ])
    new_u[i, ] = t(model2$coefficients) #1 x 2
  }
  u = new_u #56 x 2, 2 col. now
  u
  eta = new_Xenv%*%t(beta) + u%*%t(lambda) #56 x 200 + 56 x 200
  mu = exp(eta)
  loglik_new = sum(dnorm(u, log = TRUE)) + sum(dpois(as.matrix(df_noXenv[, 1:200]), lambda = mu, log = TRUE))
  if(abs(loglik_new - loglik) < 1e-3) break
  loglik = loglik_new
}})

pred_counts2 = exp(eta)

pearson_resid = (df_noXenv[, 1:200] - pred_counts2)/sqrt(pred_counts2) 
sspearson_resid = sum(pearson_resid^2)

```


```{r glmnet - penalty on lambda using 1 l.v. step size truncated due to divergence}
#install.packages('glmnet')
library(glmnet)

system.time({u = rnorm(56, 0, 1) # 1 latent variable

beta_lambda = matrix(NA, nrow = length(microbial[, 1:200]), ncol = 3)

#pen_glm = glmnet(x = cbind(Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2], u), y = df_noXenv[, 1], family = poisson(link = 'log'), alpha = 0, lambda = 1)

#pen_glm$beta
#pen_glm$a0
#beta_lambda = t(rbind(pen_glm$a0, pen_glm$beta)) #1 x 4
#beta = beta_lambda[, 1:3]
#lambda = beta_lambda[, 4]
#new_Xenv = cbind(rep(1, nrow(df_noXenv)), Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2]) #56 x 3
#new_u = matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(microbial), ncol = 1) #56 x 1

#pen_glm2 = glmnet(x = lambda, y = as.numeric(df_noXenv[1, ]), intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), offset = (new_Xenv%*%t(beta))[1, ], alpha = 0, lambda = 1)

#new_u = pen_glm2$beta


loglik = -Inf
for (j in 1:20){

  for (i in 1:length(microbial[, 1:200])){
    pen_glm = glmnet(x = cbind(Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2], u), y = df_noXenv[, i], intercept = FALSE, family = poisson(link = 'log'), alpha = 0, lambda = 1)
    
    beta_lambda[i, ] = t(c(as.numeric(pen_glm$beta))) #1 x 3, as.numeric and c() because it's stored as sparse matrix
  }
  beta_lambda #(beta lambda)
  beta = beta_lambda[, 1:2] #200 x 2
  lambda = beta_lambda[, 3] #200 x 1
  
  new_Xenv = cbind(Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2]) #56 x 2
  new_u = matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(microbial), ncol = 1) #56 x 1

  for (i in 1:nrow(df_noXenv)){
    glm2 = glm.fit(y = as.numeric(df_noXenv[i, 1:200]), x = lambda, intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), offset = (new_Xenv%*%t(beta))[i, ])
    new_u[i] = glm2$coefficients
  }
  u = new_u #56 x 1
  u
  eta = new_Xenv%*%t(beta) + u%*%t(lambda) #56 x 200 + 56 x 200
  mu = exp(eta)
  loglik_new = sum(dnorm(u, log = TRUE)) + sum(dpois(as.matrix(df_noXenv[, 1:200]), lambda = mu, log = TRUE))
  if(abs(loglik_new - loglik) < 1e-3) break
  loglik = loglik_new
}})

pred_counts2 = exp(eta)

pearson_resid = (df_noXenv[, 1:200] - pred_counts2)/sqrt(pred_counts2) 
sspearson_resid = sum(pearson_resid^2)
```

```{r glmnet - penalty on lambda using 2 l.v. step size truncated due to divergence}
#install.packages('glmnet')
library(MASS)
system.time({u = mvrnorm(n = 56, mu = c(0, 0), Sigma = matrix(c(1, 0, 0, 1), nrow = 2, ncol = 2)) # 2 latent variables
beta_lambda = matrix(NA, nrow = length(microbial[, 1:200]), ncol = 4) #4 to account for 2 l.v and 2 coefficients beta

loglik = -Inf
for (j in 1:20){

  for (i in 1:length(microbial[, 1:200])){
    pen_glm = glmnet(x = cbind(Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2], u), y = df_noXenv[, i], intercept = FALSE, family = poisson(link = 'log'), alpha = 0, lambda = 1)
    
    beta_lambda[i, ] = t(c(as.numeric(pen_glm$beta))) #1 x 4, as.numeric and c() because it's stored as sparse matrix
  }
  beta_lambda #(intercept beta lambda)
  beta = beta_lambda[, 1:2] #200 x 2
  lambda = beta_lambda[, 3:4] #200 x 2, 2 col. now
  
  new_Xenv = cbind(Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2]) #56 x 2
  new_u = matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(microbial), ncol = 2) #56 x 2, 2 col. now

  for (i in 1:nrow(df_noXenv)){
    glm2 = glm.fit(y = as.numeric(df_noXenv[i, 1:200]), x = lambda, intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), offset = (new_Xenv%*%t(beta))[i, ])
    new_u[i, ] = t(glm2$coefficients)
  }
  u = new_u #56 x 2, 2 col. now
  u
  eta = new_Xenv%*%t(beta) + u%*%t(lambda) #56 x 200 + 56 x 200
  mu = exp(eta)
  loglik_new = sum(dnorm(u, log = TRUE)) + sum(dpois(as.matrix(df_noXenv[, 1:200]), lambda = mu, log = TRUE))
  if(abs(loglik_new - loglik) < 1e-3) break
  loglik = loglik_new
}})

pred_counts2 = exp(eta)

pearson_resid = (df_noXenv[, 1:200] - pred_counts2)/sqrt(pred_counts2) 
sspearson_resid = sum(pearson_resid^2)
```

#Huber 2004 
#gmf = penalised likelihood

#glmnet using intercept = TRUE with row effects  ==> alphai + xibj + ui lambdaj for one l.v.
```{r glmnet - penalty on lambda and u using 1 l.v. Chen step size truncated due to divergence}
#install.packages('glmnet')
#library(MASS)

system.time({u = rnorm(56, 0, 1) # 1 latent variables

beta_lambda = matrix(NA, nrow = length(microbial[, 1:200]), ncol = 3)

#pen_glm = glmnet(x = cbind(Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2], u), y = df_noXenv[, 1], family = poisson(link = 'log'), alpha = 0, lambda = 1)

#pen_glm$beta
#pen_glm$a0
#beta_lambda = t(c(pen_glm$a0, as.numeric(pen_glm$beta))) #1 x 5
#beta = beta_lambda[, 1:3]
#lambda = beta_lambda[, 4:5]
#new_Xenv = cbind(rep(1, nrow(df_noXenv)), Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2]) #56 x 3
#new_u = matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(microbial), ncol = 2) #56 x 2

#pen_glm2 = glmnet(x = as.matrix(lambda), y = as.numeric(df_noXenv[1, ]), intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), offset = (new_Xenv%*%t(beta))[1, ], alpha = 0, lambda = 1)

#new_u = pen_glm2$beta


loglik = -Inf
for (j in 1:20){

  for (i in 1:length(microbial[, 1:200])){
    pen_glm = glmnet(x = cbind(Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2], u), y = df_noXenv[, i], intercept = FALSE, family = poisson(link = 'log'), alpha = 0, lambda = 5*sqrt(200))
    
    beta_lambda[i, ] = t(as.numeric(pen_glm$beta)) #1 x 3, as.numeric and c() because it's stored as sparse matrix
  }
  beta_lambda #(beta lambda)
  beta = beta_lambda[, 1:2] #200 x 2
  lambda = beta_lambda[, 3] #200 x 1
  
  new_Xenv = cbind(Xenv[, 1], Xenv[, 2]) #56 x 2
  new_u = matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(microbial), ncol = 1) #56 x 1

  for (i in 1:nrow(df_noXenv)){
    pen_glm2 = glmnet(x = cbind(lambda, rep(0, length(lambda))), y = as.numeric(df_noXenv[i, 1:200]), intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), offset = (new_Xenv%*%t(beta))[i, ], alpha = 0, lambda = 5*sqrt(200))
    new_u[i, ] = t(as.numeric(pen_glm2$beta)[1])
  }
  u = new_u #56 x 1
  u
  eta = new_Xenv%*%t(beta) + u%*%t(lambda) #56 x 200 + 56 x 200
  mu = exp(eta)
  loglik_new = sum(dnorm(u, log = TRUE)) + sum(dpois(as.matrix(df_noXenv[, 1:200]), lambda = mu, log = TRUE))
  if(abs(loglik_new - loglik) < 1e-3) break
  loglik = loglik_new
}}) 

pred_counts2 = exp(eta)

pearson_resid = (df_noXenv[, 1:200] - pred_counts2)/sqrt(pred_counts2) 
sspearson_resid = sum(pearson_resid^2)
```
